ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% low-intensity black pixels and 35% high-intensity white/mottled pixels on the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling is concentrated on the distal and upper margins of both lobes, with more extensive white coverage on the left lobe tip. The central and basal regions are dominated by contiguous low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an acute interior angle approximately between 30 and 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-15 pixels along the continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve sweeping upward to sharp, elongated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast white circular clusters of barnacles at both distal lobe tips. Several isolated white circular spots are visible on the medial portion of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, vertical high-contrast linear disruption (white scratch) is visible on the inner-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lobe tips and a prominent vertical linear scar on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark brown biological material or debris entangled with the barnacle cluster at the extreme tip of the left lobe.
